name: fly-dumbbell-incline
title: Fly: Dumbbell (Incline)
primer: This is an exercise for chest sculpting and strengthening.
steps: Lie on an incline bench set at a 45 degree angle with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet firmly on the ground.
Lift the dumbbells over your chest extending your arms fully and your palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells towards the floor in an arc like motion.
Slowly return to the starting position.
tips: Ensure your hips and back remain in contact with the bench throughout the exercise.
